verdict.rationale: Airbyte connections can be scheduled to run autonomously via cron/scheduled intervals, with built-in notifications and a connection timeline for monitoring, plus API/Terraform for programmatic automation of syncs (airbyte-docs-8,30,35,53,9,26,34,10,54,3,19). Community posts confirm real-world autonomous background use (self-hosted syncs running unattended) though with some setup friction reported (airbyte-comm-4,7,1). Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of long-running unattended reliability at scale and clearer failure/retry semantics beyond notifications.
